promotion_eligible_options.reason: Preserve the user's required traversal, shared aim, drop capture, and unsupported lethal-assumption fixes. Other configurations are diagnostic controls only.

selection: One eligible candidate with highest screening mean; break ties by fewer changed component families, then stable identifier. Freeze source hashes before validation. No holdout-based retuning or replacement winner.
environment: Frozen v3 geometry; analytic segment-cylinder intersection and actual body radius in movement, identically applied to all variants. No optical canopy model. Uncontrolled HashMap tie iteration remains.
scope: Complete the predefined outstanding component/interaction experiments. If no candidate passes the prospective gate, do not push or tune repeatedly on the holdout.
publication: Authorized only if the gate passes. Preserve v3/v4 and prior candidate; publish exact tested source to the repository default branch without force pushing. No official competition submission authorized or automated.
